title: Install a package from the AUR using paru
summary: Use paru to search for and install packages from the Arch User Repository (AUR) or official repositories. It acts as a wrapper for pacman, handling the build and installation process interactively.

aliases.text: how to install package with paru

steps.explain: Search for the package and install it. Paru will ask for confirmation and may prompt for sudo password during the build/install phase.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE_NAME_OR_SEARCH_TERM
placeholders.description: The name of the package you want to install or a search term to find it.

alternatives.explain: Searches for the package name or keyword in both official repositories and the AUR, then prompts you to select which packages to install.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE_NAME
placeholders.description: Name or search term for the package

rollback.explain: Remove the package, its configuration files, and dependencies that are no longer needed.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE_NAME
placeholders.description: The exact name of the installed package.

warnings: Installing from the AUR involves building software from source. Always verify the PKGBUILD and source integrity if you are unsure about the package's safety.
This command may require administrator privileges (sudo) to install the final package.
